Status: CLOSED
Requesting Application: Coordination
Application Branch: N/A
Application Commit/Evidence: Repository issue #1
Classification: MISSING
Blocking: NON_BLOCKING

Requested Foundation Capability / Contract Behavior:
Document the activation of the shared FCR workflow itself.

Evidence of Gap:
Application and Foundation workstreams previously had no neutral repository-wide intake channel for cross-workstream capability requests.

Application Impact:
Without a shared channel, Foundation capability requests could be stranded in branch-local documents and missed by the opposite workstream.

Required Behavior (do not prescribe Foundation internals):
Use GitHub Issues as the neutral shared FCR transport while preserving branch ownership.

Relevant Foundation References (if known):
Issue #1 defines the operating protocol.

Foundation Triage:
COORDINATION_CONTROL_ESTABLISHED

Foundation Disposition:
NO_FOUNDATION_IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED

Foundation Evidence/Commit:
N/A

Application Verification:
N/A

Closure Evidence:
Repository issue #1 established the shared FCR registry and protocol. This issue is documentary only and creates no implementation authority.
